questions.stem_markdown:
Box A contains 6 green balls and 3 yellow balls.

Box B contains 4 green balls and $x$ yellow balls.

A ball is chosen at random from box A and placed in box B. A ball is then chosen at random from box B.

mark_scheme_items.content_markdown: Box A Box B $$\begin{matrix}5 \\ 5+x \\ G \\ \frac{6}{9} \\ G \\ \frac{x}{5+x} \\ Y \\ \frac{3}{9} \\ 4 \\ 5+x \\ G \\ \frac{1+x}{5+x} \\ Y \end{matrix}$$
mark_scheme_items.guidance_markdown: Correct structure and probabilities for Box A branches.
Completely correct structure and one correct probability for a Box B branch including label for G or Y.
Completely correct structure and second correct probability on a Box B branch including label G or Y.

Completely correct structure and remaining two probabilities correct on Box B branches, including labels for G or Y. **SC B1** if correct shape diagram but only four correct algebraic probs for GG, GY, YG and YY.

$$P(GG) + P(YY) = \left( \frac{6}{9} \text{ or } \frac{3}{9} \right) \times \text{their} \left( \frac{5}{5+x} \right) + \left( \frac{3}{9} \text{ or } \frac{6}{9} \right) \times \text{their} \left( \frac{1+x}{5+x} \right)$$

mark_scheme_items.content_markdown: $$\frac{6}{9} \times \frac{5}{5+x} + \frac{3}{9} \times \frac{1+x}{5+x} = \frac{8}{15} \text{ and arrange as a linear equation}$$
mark_scheme_items.guidance_markdown: $$15(x+11) = 24(x+5) \text{ OE}$$ Accept sum of their products equated to $$\frac{8}{15}$$ and rearranged to form a linear equation.
